name: Video Interview
delivery: Asynchronous, or live in the two-way mode
interviewer: Recorded prompts, an AI avatar, or your own team live
scoring: AI, against your rubric; a human makes every call
best_for: First-round screening of every applicant, at volume

name: Recorded Video Interview
interviewer: Preset question sets you configure; nobody in the room
scoring: AI, against your rubric; the panel rates on weighted scorecards
best_for: High-volume screening where scheduling is the bottleneck

name: Conversational AI Avatar Interview
interviewer: An AI avatar following your script, with follow-ups drawn from your question set
scoring: AI, against your rubric; hiring managers also rate the recording
best_for: Volume screening where every candidate must get identical questions

name: 2-Way Interview
scoring: Two or three interviewers score independently; the AI scores beside them without overruling
best_for: Final-stage rounds run live by your own team

name: Voice Interview
interviewer: An automated spoken round from your question sets, with follow-ups
scoring: AI, against your rubric; a human makes every call

name: Chat Interview
interviewer: Text chat from your question sets, with adaptive follow-ups
scoring: AI, against your rubric; AI-written answers flagged to a reviewer
best_for: Roles where writing is the job; candidates who freeze on camera

name: Conversational Chat Interview
interviewer: A written back-and-forth from your question set; follow-ups when an answer is thin
scoring: AI, against your rubric; flags go to a human reviewer
best_for: Assessing written work rather than recall, with no clock

name: MCQ Rounds
interviewer: Multiple-choice items from your own question banks
scoring: Auto-marked against the declared answers; no model involved
best_for: Threshold knowledge checks with a real pass floor

name: Timed Q&A
interviewer: Timed written questions from your question sets
scoring: AI, against your rubric; a partial answer is scored on what is there
best_for: What candidates know, and how they write under time pressure
